summary: Return descriptors for all own string and Symbol keys, preserving property attributes.

semantics.keys: all own string and Symbol keys in OwnPropertyKeys order
semantics.result: ordinary object mapping each key to a fresh descriptor object

caveats: Non-enumerable and Symbol keys must be included.
Proxy traps can affect ownKeys and descriptors.

tests.name: includes nonenumerable
tests.input: const x={}; Object.defineProperty(x,'a',{value:1}); console.log('a' in Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(x));
